note: The main banks were taken as Bulgaria's three largest by assets, a choice from general knowledge (no central bank or association ranking was read in this pass): UniCredit Bulbank, DSK Bank and UBB. DSK Bank: its tariff for individuals (in force from 1 September 2026), whose bank cards section links each card's own sheet, the sheet for its Visa credit cards with revolving credit (the card the April 2026 tariff called Visa Galaxy, now the 'Credit card'), and its credit card page, read 2026-10-30. The card costs 25 euros a year for the main card; the fee isn't charged where the card makes 24 transactions in its first year, or under some of the bank's plans, conditions the game doesn't check, so it is charged in full. It bears 18.90% a year, the page's standard loan interest rate, with up to 45 days without interest. A withdrawal at DSK's own ATMs costs 2.10 euros plus 3% (3.60 plus 3% at others, not written), and an unpaid minimum 8 euros, written as the late fee. The Platinum credit card is issued only under the bank's Premium and Private Banking plans from 1 July 2026, and the DSK-Wizz Air card only to specific client segments, so neither is written. The page doesn't state the minimum's share. UniCredit Bulbank's card pages answered with a captcha, UBB's refused the request (403) and Postbank's answered with a Cloudflare check, so none is written.
